ambient_events: Down through the glass floor the dancefloor churns, silent up here behind the soundproofing: a storm in a jar.
A bottle arrives at a neighbouring booth trailing a live sparkler and a woman carrying it like a torch.
The private feed on the wall cuts to a slow overhead shot of the floor below, then to your own booth, then away.
Someone laughs behind frosted glass, the sound expensive and unhurried.
The lighting warms half a degree, the way a room does when it's decided you belong in it.
description: The VIP mezzanine hangs over the floor behind a wall of soundproof glass, so the storm below plays out in total silence beneath your feet. The booths are deep half-moons of oxblood leather around low tables, each with its own bottle service and its own pool of warm, private light. Up here the bass is a suggestion you feel through the floor rather than hear, and the only people who make it past the rope are the ones who could buy the rope. A discreet bar tends the far corner, stocked with things that never see the main-floor menu.
name: VIP Mezzanine
